Process / Steps

offer.process-steps

What happens next, in order

numberedtimelinecardsvertical-list
numbered

What happens next

Four simple steps from first call to a smile you can keep.

  1. 1Tell us what you need

    A short call or form. We listen first and ask only what helps.

  2. 2Meet and plan

    A full check, honest options and a written plan with prices.

  3. 3Treatment, your pace

    Done in comfortable stages, with updates after each visit.

  4. 4Follow-up and care

    Reminders, check-ins and a simple routine to protect results.

FAQ

answer.faq

Direct answer first, then conditions

accordiontwo-columncardstab-list
accordion

Frequently asked questions

Everything people ask before their first visit.

01Do I need to book in advance?

Booking helps us give you a full slot, but we keep daily gaps for urgent visits.

02Is the first consultation free?

Your first consultation is free; X-rays are charged at a flat rate.

03Do you treat children?

Yes. We see children from age three in a calmer, shorter appointment format.

04Which payment methods do you accept?

Cards, UPI and most major insurance providers.

05What should I bring to my first visit?

Any previous X-rays or reports you have, a list of medicines you take, and your insurance card if you have one.

06How long does a check-up take?

Most check-ups take about 30 minutes, including the cleaning and a short plan for what comes next.

07Will treatment hurt?

We use local anaesthetic and a gentle approach, and we pause whenever you ask. Most patients tell us it was easier than they expected.

08Can I get a second opinion here?

Yes. Bring your records and we will explain the options and the price before you decide anything.

Still have a question?Call +91 98765 43210 or message us.

Yes. We see children from age three in a calmer, shorter appointment format.

Which payment methods do you accept?

Cards, UPI and most major insurance providers.

What should I bring to my first visit?

Any previous X-rays or reports you have, a list of medicines you take, and your insurance card if you have one.

How long does a check-up take?

Most check-ups take about 30 minutes, including the cleaning and a short plan for what comes next.

Will treatment hurt?

We use local anaesthetic and a gentle approach, and we pause whenever you ask. Most patients tell us it was easier than they expected.

Can I get a second opinion here?

Yes. Bring your records and we will explain the options and the price before you decide anything.

Single article with headline, author, dates

single-columnwith-sidebar
single-column
Prevention

How often should you really get a check-up?

MRDr. Meera RaoLead dentist 12 September 2025 5 min read
article cover

Most people are told six months. The honest answer depends on your mouth, not the calendar.

What most adults need

For many adults with healthy gums, one or two check-ups a year is plenty. The goal is to catch small changes while they are still small.

“The best dentistry is the kind you barely have to think about.”Dr. Meera Rao, Founder

When to come more often

Gum disease, a history of cavities, braces, pregnancy or diabetes all make shorter gaps sensible. Your dentist should explain why, in plain words.

What to ask at your next visit

Ask how your gums look, what has changed since last time and what one habit would help most. Small questions lead to useful answers.

Share this article

Chef portrait
Chef story

Chef Anika Rao

Head chef and co-founder

Anika grew up cooking beside her grandmother and trained in kitchens across three cities before opening a place of her own. Her rule is simple: buy what is in season, cook it with care and let it taste like itself.

  • Cooks with 40 local suppliers
  • Menu changes every season
  • Zero single-use plastics

Text Block

content.text-block

Editorial text, story or letter without a strong visual

single-columnnarrow-columntwo-columnletter
single-column

Our approach

We believe good care starts with a good conversation. Before any treatment, you will hear what we see, what your options are and what each one costs.

Nothing is rushed and nothing is hidden. If a treatment can wait, we will say so. If a second opinion would help, we will arrange it.

That is a small promise, and we keep it at every visit.

narrow-column

Our approach

We believe good care starts with a good conversation. Before any treatment, you will hear what we see, what your options are and what each one costs.

Nothing is rushed and nothing is hidden. If a treatment can wait, we will say so. If a second opinion would help, we will arrange it.

That is a small promise, and we keep it at every visit.

two-column
Our approach

Our approach

We believe good care starts with a good conversation. Before any treatment, you will hear what we see, what your options are and what each one costs.

Nothing is rushed and nothing is hidden. If a treatment can wait, we will say so. If a second opinion would help, we will arrange it.

That is a small promise, and we keep it at every visit.

letter

Dear patient,

Thank you for trusting us with something as personal as your health. We have built this clinic around one idea: that you should always know what is happening and why.

If anything is unclear, ask. If something worries you, tell us. We would rather answer a hundred questions than have you leave with one.

Warmly,

Dr. Meera Rao

Milestones in order over time

Our story so far

Milestones along the way

  1. 2017

    First clinic opens

    Two chairs and a promise to explain everything.

  2. 2019

    Digital imaging added

    Low-dose X-rays and a screen you can look at together.

  3. 2021

    Kids and family wing

    A calmer, shorter format for children.

  4. 2023

    Second clinic

    More evening and weekend slots.

  5. 2025

    Care plans launch

    Yearly plans with prices fixed in advance.
